ModMetaData.name: Plasmorph Art Override
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description: Replaces Alpha Animals's AA_Plasmorph art (south/east/north facings only) with a render generated for this campaign (Cauldron sheet 2026-10-04, owner pick B). LABEL/ART ONLY - no defName touched, no Defs, no Patches, loose Textures/ only, same relative path (Things/Pawn/Animal/AA_Plasmorph/AA_Plasmorph_<facing>) the donor uses so this mod's later load order wins the same-path resolution.
